HOW IT WORKS

From our supplier.
Straight to you.

Renovation hardware for plumbers, builders, renovators and homeowners. You pay at checkout, we place the order with our supplier, and it ships direct to your site or door.

Six steps, most of them automatic.

01

Choose your product

Browse the shop. Check the material, sizes, finishes and where it ships from. Ask us if anything is unclear before you buy.

02

Pay at checkout

Pay through secure Shopify checkout. Prices are in AUD with GST included, and the delivery cost is shown before you pay.

03

We place your order

Your order and delivery address go to our supplier automatically. You don’t need to contact anyone.

04

Shipped direct to you

The supplier ships straight to your site or door. Most orders take about 2 to 3 weeks; that is the supplier’s estimate, not a guarantee. We share tracking once we have it.

05

We sort any problem

If something arrives damaged, faulty or wrong, or doesn’t arrive, contact FI with your order number. We deal with the supplier for you.

06

Share your experience

After a real paid order is recorded as delivered, review the product from My orders. We publish genuine positive and negative experiences under the same rules.

HONEST LISTINGS

What you see is what ships.

Each listing shows the material, sizes, finishes, where it ships from and the supplier’s delivery estimate. Shop orders go straight from the supplier to you, so FI does not inspect them before delivery. AI catalogue renders are labelled.

Buying for a job or in bulk? Send us your list for a quote. For larger orders we can arrange warehouse inspection before dispatch.

If something goes wrong

Contact FI if a product arrives damaged, faulty or incorrect, or doesn’t arrive. We arrange the repair, replacement or refund that applies. Your Australian Consumer Law rights apply to every order.
